source_refs.note: Book p. 49: 4.2 Matrix Operations, the introductory paragraph before 4.2.1. The list of the four operations follows the sub-headings; Teaching notes, Key points and Common mistake are ours.

blocks.text: Pichle page par hum ne matrix ki zubaan seekhi: order, entries, aur matrices ki qisamein. Ab hum matrices ke saath hisaab karna seekhenge. Jaise numbers ko jama, tafreeq aur zarb karte hain, waise hi matrices ke saath bhi kuch operations (amal) hote hain, lekin un ke apne qaide hain.

Kitab kehti hai: matrix operations woh mukhtalif tareeqe aur amal hain jo matrices par kiye jate hain. Yeh operations linear algebra (matrices aur equations wali algebra) ki buniyad hain, aur computer graphics, physics, statistics waghera jaise bohat se shobon mein kaam aate hain. Kuch aham matrix operations yeh hain:

items: 4.2.4 Multiplication of two matrices (do matrices ki zarb)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Numbers ke saath aap hamesha jama, tafreeq aur zarb kar sakte hain. Matrices ke saath pehle orders check karne parte hain:
1. Addition aur subtraction ke liye dono matrices ka order same hona chahiye.
2. Scalar multiplication (aam number guna matrix) hamesha mumkin hai.
3. Product \(AB\) tab banta hai jab \(A\) ke columns ki tadaad \(B\) ki rows ki tadaad ke barabar ho.
Is liye har operation se pehle khud se poochiye: "Kya in orders ke liye yeh amal define hai?" Agle chaar pages mein har operation alag alag, us ke qaide ki wajah ke saath, samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh operations kahan kaam aate hain? Computer ya mobile ki screen par jab koi tasveer ghumayi, khiskayi ya bari ki jati hai, to us ke points ke coordinates ko ek matrix se multiply kiya jata hai. Statistics mein data ka table, jaise kai dukaanon ki kai mahinon ki sales, ek matrix hai. Do mahinon ke aise tables ko khana ba khana jama karna matrix addition hai. Yeh baatein is unit ke aakhir mein 4.10 mein dobara aayengi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahin. Ek dukaan January mein do cheezein do branches mein bechti hai: Branch 1 mein 10 aur 4, Branch 2 mein 7 aur 6. February mein: Branch 1 mein 5 aur 3, Branch 2 mein 2 aur 8. Dono mahinon ka kul jama karna ho to har khane ko alag alag jama karein:
\[\begin{bmatrix}10 & 4 \\ 7 & 6\end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix}5 & 3 \\ 2 & 8\end{bmatrix}\]
\[= \begin{bmatrix}15 & 7 \\ 9 & 14\end{bmatrix}\]
Yahi matrix addition hai, jo agle page 4.2.1 ka mauzu hai. Dhyan dein: yeh tabhi mumkin hai jab dono tables ki shakal (order) ek jaisi ho.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Kya \(\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \end{bmatrix}\) aur \(\begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}\) ko jama kiya ja sakta hai?
Jawab: nahin. Pehli \(1 \times 3\) hai aur doosri \(3 \times 1\). Numbers same hain lekin shakal alag; jama karne ke liye har entry ka aamne saamne wala saathi chahiye, jo yahan mojood nahin.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Chaar bunyadi operations: addition, subtraction, scalar multiplication, aur do matrices ka multiplication.
2. Har operation tabhi define hai jab orders mel khayein.
3. Addition aur subtraction khana ba khana (entry by entry) hote hain; multiplication row guna column hota hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text: Matrices ko aam numbers samajh kar orders check kiye baghair jama ya zarb kar dena. \(2 \times 3\) aur \(3 \times 2\) matrices ko jama nahin kiya ja sakta, halaan ke dono mein chhe chhe entries hain. Bachne ka tareeqa: har sawal mein pehli line par dono matrices ke order likh lijiye.
